item.description:
The Jonas Brothers: The 3D Concert Experience (1080p HD) [BDREMUX]​


​
This rockumentary follows the Jonas Brothers during their trip across the United States on their 'Burning Up Tour' of 2009. Presented in Disney Digital 3-D, locations for the piece include Anaheim, California's Honda Centre, and New York's Madison Square Garden. The film also features backstage adventures and guest performers.
​


More information: https://www.blu-ray.com/movies/The-Jonas-Brothers-The-3-D-Concert-Experience-Blu-ray/14541/
